### BitGo Deepens Its Relationship with Aptos


November 10, 2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s21.q4cdn.com/773293151/files/doc_news/BitGo-Deepens-Its-Relationship-with-Aptos-2026.pdf)


NEW YORK--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


BitGo Holdings, Inc. (NYSE: BTGO) (“BitGo”), the digital asset infrastructure company, today announced BitGo has taken a strategic position in APT, the native token of Aptos network. The move builds on BitGo's existing support for institutions operating in Aptos, including custody for APT and assets built on the Aptos Digital Asset Standard, APT staking, and self-custody wallet connectivity to Decibel, a decentralized exchange (DEX) built on Aptos.


BitGo’s work with Aptos spans custody, staking, and access to onchain markets. Eligible clients can custody and stake APT through BitGo. Institutional clients using BitGo self-custody wallets can also elect to connect to Decibel through their existing wallet approval workflows.


“Institutional adoption tends to follow solid infrastructure,” said Michael Ching, Head of Treasury and Operations at Aptos Foundation. “BitGo has been building on Aptos for some time, and we’re excited to see that commitment continue to grow. We look forward to deepening the partnership even more together.”


"APT secures the Aptos network and powers every transaction on it," said Solomon Tesfaye, Chief Business Officer at Aptos Labs. "BitGo's strategic position in APT underscores its commitment to Aptos, and we're glad to see the partnership keep growing as we broaden onchain finance adoption together."


“Institutions need infrastructure that lets them participate in digital asset networks while maintaining the controls they rely on,” said Abel Seow, Managing Director and Head of APAC Sales at BitGo. “Our work with Aptos already spans custody, staking, and connectivity to onchain markets. This is a continuation of the relationship we’ve built together.”


**About Aptos**


[Aptos](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Faptosfoundation.org%2F&esheet=54625854&newsitemid=20261030442045&lan=en-US&anchor=Aptos&index=1&md5=ff705cf3d15ff9887790c3f58ebaceeb) is a next-generation Layer 1 blockchain. Aptos’ breakthrough technology, scalable infrastructure and user safeguards are designed to power the next generation of financial systems by offering unparalleled high throughput and low latency that can scale to billions of users.


**About BitGo**


BitGo (NYSE: BTGO) is the digital asset infrastructure company delivering custody, wallets, staking, trading, financing, stablecoins, and settlement services from regulated cold storage. Since 2013, BitGo has focused on accelerating the transition of the financial system to a digital asset economy. BitGo maintains a global presence and multiple regulated entities, including BitGo Bank & Trust, National Association, the first federally chartered digital asset trust bank owned by a publicly traded company. Today, BitGo serves thousands of institutions, including many of the industry's top brands, financial institutions, exchanges, and platforms, and millions of investors worldwide. For more information, visit[www.bitgo.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.bitgo.com&esheet=54625854&newsitemid=20261030442045&lan=en-US&anchor=www.bitgo.com&index=2&md5=2f5dc69793fb7dc2c1b59703c5145365) .
